design_philosophy: Motorsport/Racing aesthetics adapted for a premium driving school. Thrilling, technical, fast, but reliable. High contrast, diagonal cuts, aggressive typography, and telemetry-style data display.

mono.usage: Telemetry data, stat numbers, overlines, technical details.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders in neutral colors, switching to primary red on hover/active.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Diagonal cuts (clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 95% 100%, 0% 100%)), skewed buttons (skew-x-[-10deg]) with counter-skewed text.
visual_enhancers.textures: Carbon fiber backgrounds, racing checkered micro-patterns, speedlines (horizontal fading lines).

layout_patterns.spacing: Generous vertical spacing (py-24 to py-32) for sections. Tight horizontal grids for telemetry stats.
layout_patterns.alignment: Aggressive asymmetrical layouts. Overlapping images over dark structural blocks.

micro_interactions.buttons: Hovering triggers 'brake-light' red glow (neon_red shadow) and slight forward translation (translate-x-1).
micro_interactions.cards: Hover scales up slightly, border transitions from subtle grey to racing red.
micro_interactions.scroll: Framer motion stagger entry from the side (like cars entering a starting grid).

hero_background.description: Dark carbon fiber texture for the main background.

fleet_audi.description: Red sports car mimicking the Audi S3.

fleet_opel.description: Blue sports car mimicking the Opel OPC.

components_blueprint.name: PreviewBanner
components_blueprint.description: Fixed top banner (z-[100]) indicating this is the 'Sport/Racing Variante'. Contains a button to route back to '/' (Original Design). Black text on Racing Red background, monospace.

components_blueprint.name: SportHero
components_blueprint.description: Massive typography 'Anders. Besser. Mutiger.' in Bebas Neue. Background features carbon fiber texture with subtle horizontal framer-motion speedlines. Includes primary CTA 'Anfragen' and direct call CTA with brake-light glow.

components_blueprint.name: SportMarquee
components_blueprint.description: Fast-moving ticker using framer-motion or react-fast-marquee. Red background, black text. Content: Kantone (ZH, SZ, SG, GR) separated by inline SVG checkered flags.

components_blueprint.name: SportStatsBar
components_blueprint.description: Telemetry-style dashboard. JetBrains Mono font. Deep black container with red accent borders. Shows 11 Standorte, 5.0 Rating, 4 Kantone in digital readout style.

components_blueprint.name: SportFleet
components_blueprint.description: Starting grid layout. 3 Cars (Audi, Opel, Range Rover) presented in aggressive diagonal-cut cards. Hovering on a card illuminates it and dims the others.

components_blueprint.name: SportServices
components_blueprint.description: Race schedule timeline. Vertical line (track) down the center/left with services branching off. High contrast, structured, technical typography.

components_blueprint.name: SportContact
components_blueprint.description: Named 'Boxenstopp'. Contact form enclosed in a carbon-fiber styled card with red accents. Input fields are dark zinc with red focus rings.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do NOT modify the existing components or pages. Build everything for the Motorsport variant inside '/app/frontend/src/components/sport/'.
2. Create a new page '/app/frontend/src/pages/SportPreview.jsx' and assemble the new components there.
3. Set up a route in the main App routing for '/preview/sport' pointing to the new SportPreview page.
4. Update Tailwind config with the requested font imports: Bebas Neue, Outfit, JetBrains Mono.
5. Use Framer Motion for the staggered grid entries and speedline background animations.
6. Apply 'data-testid' to all interactive elements as specified.
7. Implement skewed buttons: A common pattern is wrapping text in a span that counter-skews: .
8. Implement Lucide React icons. Avoid using emojis.
